## Summary statistics by group

Pending

### Number of kids

Pending

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sum-kids
#| tbl-cap: Total number of kids by segment and ownership home
#| message: false
sum_kids_table <- segmentation |>
    group_by(
        Segment,
        ownHome
    ) |>
    summarise(
        sum_kids = sum(kids)
    ) |>
    ungroup()

sum_kids_table |>
    datatable(
        colnames = c(
            "Segment",
            "Ownership home",
            "Total kids"
        )
    )
```

### Frequencies by group

Pending

```{r}
#| label: tbl-subscriptions-segment-owner-home
#| tbl-cap: Subscriptions by segment and home ownership
subscriber_by_segment_home_ownership <- segmentation |>
    count(
        subscribe,
        Segment,
        ownHome
    ) |>
    group_by(
        Segment,
        ownHome
    ) |>
    mutate(
        n_pct = (n / sum(n)) * 100
    ) |>
    arrange(Segment, ownHome) |>
    ungroup()

subscriber_by_segment_home_ownership |>
    datatable(
        colnames = c(
            "Status subscription",
            "Segment",
            "Ownership home",
            "Number",
            "Percentage"
        )
    ) |>
    formatRound(
        columns = 5,
        digits = 2
    )
```

### Visualization

Pending

#### Frequencies

```{r}
#| label: subscriptions-segment-owner-home
#| fig-cap: Percentage of subscriptions by segment and ownership home
subscriber_by_segment_home_ownership |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_col(
        aes(
            x = subscribe,
            y = n_pct
        )
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
        facets = vars(
            Segment,
            ownHome
        ),
        nrow = 2
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Subscription status",
        y = "Percentage (%)"
    )
```

#### Continous variables by groups

```{r}
#| label: fig-distribution-income-segment-own-home
#| fig-cap: Distribution of income by segment and ownership home
segmentation |>
    ggplot() +
    geom_boxplot(
        aes(
            x = income,
            y = Segment
        )
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
        facets = vars(ownHome)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
        labels = label_currency()
    ) +
    labs(
        x = "Yearly Disposable income (USD Dollars)"
    )
```
